label: exploit_drop0.05
rationale: Current best with a tiny touch of dropout — at D=20k a hint of regularization on top of wd=0.1 may help generalization without hurting fit.

label: exploit_lr3e-3
rationale: Slightly lower LR than the winner (5e-3). bs=1024 likes high LR but 3e-3 may yield a smoother minimum.

label: exploit_lr7e-3
rationale: Bump LR slightly above the winner — both 5e-3 and 1e-2 worked; 7e-3 is the unexplored midpoint.

label: exploit_wd0.03
rationale: Loosen weight decay from 0.1 toward the D=100k optimum (0.019). May give model more capacity at D=20k.

label: exploit_wd0.05_drop0.1
rationale: Trade some wd for dropout — different regularization mechanism may complement at moderate dataset size.

label: exploit_bs512
rationale: Halve batch size — more update steps per epoch at D=20k may improve convergence at fixed LR.

label: exploit_bs512_lr3e-3
rationale: Scale LR with smaller batch (linear scaling rule: bs/2 -> lr/~1.7). Tests sqrt-scaling intuition.

label: exploit_bs2048_equiv_lr8e-3
rationale: Higher LR with same large batch — explore the LR=1e-2 (test=0.522) vs LR=5e-3 (test=0.519) frontier more finely.

label: exploit_ks7
rationale: Wider receptive field (ks=7) — may capture longer motifs/dependencies on 200bp inserts at D=20k.

label: exploit_rcshift_aug
rationale: Add shift augmentation on top of RC — more data augmentation at D=20k could help generalization.

label: explore_wider_8stage
rationale: Double-width 8-stage with regularization — D=20k may support more capacity than D=100k's 3-stage winner.

label: explore_constant256_5stage
rationale: Constant-width architecture preserves capacity throughout depth. 5 stages, 200bp -> ~6 spatial tokens.

label: explore_constant128_7stage
rationale: Deep narrow constant arch — D=5k second-best used depth=7 with width=128.

label: explore_pyramid_growing
rationale: Growing pyramid — opposite of the default decreasing schedule. Tests whether late-stage width matters.

label: explore_deeper_10stage
rationale: Deeper decreasing arch (10 stages) with same regularization style as the winner.

label: explore_ks3_default
rationale: Smaller kernel — pairs with depth to build receptive field via composition rather than width.

label: explore_low_lr_high_drop
rationale: Different regime: small bs + low LR + heavy dropout — tests stability of the current SGD config across regimes.

label: explore_bs64_finegrain
rationale: Reuse D=100k winner's bs/lr/wd/drop on the DEFAULT 8-stage (instead of 3-stage). Did the arch swap hurt transfer?

label: explore_extreme_wd
rationale: Replace wd with pure dropout regularization — tests whether wd=0.1 was uniquely responsible for the win.

label: explore_4stage_wide
rationale: Shallow but very wide first stage — strong feature extractor with quick downsampling.

label: hybrid_d100k_winner_bs1024
rationale: D=100k winner arch + lr/wd but bs scaled up to 1024 — does the small bs hurt at D=20k where step count is lower?

label: hybrid_d100k_w256_d3_lrup
rationale: Adapt D=100k 3-stage w=256 with higher LR like the D=20k current winner. Maybe LR was the issue, not arch.

label: hybrid_d100k_third_pbt
rationale: D=100k third place (pbt) compressed to 2-stage, scaled batch + LR — bare-minimum capacity test.

label: hybrid_d100k_4th_wider
rationale: Adapt D=100k 4th place (w=256, d=2). Slight depth bump and decreasing width to match D=20k regime.

label: hybrid_d5k_pbt_wider
rationale: D=5k PBT winner config (lr=6e-4, bs=512, no reg, d=4) widened to 256 base. Tests low-data regime transfer up.

label: hybrid_d5k_random_wider
rationale: D=5k 2nd place: deep w=128 with high LR, light wd, dropout=0.2. Different regime than current best — worth a shot.

label: hybrid_d5k_optuna_scaleup
rationale: D=5k optuna winner: high LR + bs=1024 + w=256 d=3 + drop=0.2 + no wd. Closely aligns with current D=20k bs/lr.

label: hybrid_d100k_arch_default_wd
rationale: D=100k arch (3-stage w=256) with D=20k current best optimizer hps. Isolates ARCHITECTURE effect.

label: hybrid_d5k_d100k_blend
rationale: Mid-depth (5 stages) blending D=5k/D=100k traits: moderate bs/lr, moderate drop, weak wd.

label: hybrid_d100k_5th_pbt_adapted
rationale: D=100k 5th place (w=128, d=2, pbt) — increased depth slightly, lowered bs and wd a notch for D=20k regime.
